paragraphs: The home page sets out three product lines: an inmate telephone system, a postal mail elimination service, and tablet and kiosk platforms. The telephone system is named SmartEvo, and the page describes it as carrying advanced technology and investigative features. MailGuard Postal Mail Elimination is the postal product, and the page says it eliminates contraband, generates and retains investigative intelligence, and adds safety at no cost.

Kiosk and tablet delivery is described as covering electronic communications, education, and entertainment. The page lists phones, tablets, kiosks, visitation, postal mail processing, electronic messaging, educational resources, and inmate entertainment as parts of a single platform. That combined platform is called SmartEcosystem on the page, which states that it comes at zero cost.

quote.text: The results? An all-in-one inmate communication platform, our industry-leading SmartEcosystem™, all at zero cost.
